QuestInfo.name: Strange World: Henesys Revisited
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce makes a good argument. Helping those in need seems like a great way to familiarize yourself with this place.
QuestInfo.2: There's word of something strange happening in the Swamp Region. You should travel to Kerning City in the Swamp Region to learn more about it.
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce seems like she's trustworthy, so you share your current situation with her.

0.msg: You might learn a lot more about this place by helping the people in it. Once you're ready, I'll guide you to your destination.
